idea-plugin.name: Restart
idea-plugin.description:
Restart can restart your IDE instantly without closing the running application.
Click File menu and select Restart or use Ctrl + Alt + R.

Welcome to reward.

Feedback & Reviews
Found a bug or have an idea? Please leave a review on the JetBrains Marketplace plugin page.
遇到问题或有功能建议，欢迎在 Marketplace 插件页留下评价。

Additional Information
Plugin ID: com.childeshu.restart
Default shortcut: Ctrl + Alt + R
Compatible with: all IntelliJ Platform IDEs 2023.1+ (build 231+), including IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, DataGrip and more
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 (2026-11-18) - Initial release / 首个版本
  • Restart the IDE instantly from the File menu (placed right before Exit). 在 File 菜单新增 Restart（位于 Exit 之前），一键立即重启 IDE。
  • Keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Alt + R in the $default keymap. 默认快捷键 Ctrl + Alt + R。
  • No configuration and no extra windows: uses the native platform restart API. 无需配置，调用平台原生重启能力，不产生额外窗口或残留进程。
